description: This file defines the Dompdf class, which extends the Pdf class to implement PDF writing functionality using the Dompdf external library in the PhpSpreadsheet project. It includes methods for creating an external Dompdf instance, preparing the spreadsheet for save, setting paper size and orientation, generating HTML, rendering the PDF, and saving the output to a file.

classes.name: Dompdf
classes.description: A class that extends the Pdf class to implement PDF writing functionality using the Dompdf external library. It manages the creation of the Dompdf instance, setting up the PDF parameters, rendering, and saving the PDF file.

methods.name: createExternalWriterInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the external Dompdf class used for rendering PDFs.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the spreadsheet as a PDF file with specified filename, handling paper size, orientation, PDF generation, and file writing.
